task_instance: Rapid-prototyping mode: build and run a minimal Foundry hosted agent (Responses API, Basic sample) wired to a governed Foundry toolbox and a React/Vite + FastAPI app, then pass the hosted integration checkpoint (a real model request) against a Foundry project, as the skill's core end-to-end agentic-loop deliverable.
blocker_detail: The skill's entire core deliverable is building and operating agentic solutions on Microsoft's hosted cloud platform (the Foundry project, hosted agents exposing the Responses API, a Foundry toolbox, Foundry IQ grounding, and deployment of the container app to the vendor's cloud). Every mode (rapid prototyping, SDD, improve) performs platform operations against that cloud service and the hosted integration checkpoint requires a live model request to it. This workstation is air-gapped with no network of any kind, so the hosted platform cannot be reached and no model request, project create/validate, or deployment can complete. Compounding this, the mandatory bootstrap step needs the companion microsoft-foundry skill, which is not present and whose only install paths in the skill are network package/plugin installs; the required CLIs az and azd and the copilot plugin host are not installed; and the platform would additionally require an authenticated cloud account/tenant (explicitly disallowed). Per the run rules I did not write any replacement, stub or mock of the missing platform, SDK or scripts.
evidence: Work dir created at real2_work/r127 (pwd confirmed). Tool probe in the work dir: 'az' MISSING, 'azd' MISSING, 'copilot' MISSING; present: gh 2.89.0, node v22.22.0, python3 3.13.17.
